attribution: Opening years are commissioning, first commercial operation, or public dedication as given by the operating agency, PIB, a ministry, or a contemporary newspaper. Coordinates are site or corridor representative points, not cadastral surveys. Displacement notes appear only where a published source exists, and competing counts are left side by side.
comparability: Cost figures are omitted. A rupee of 1959 and a rupee of 2017 are not the same object, and agency outlays are not a census of what was spent. Programmes (Bharatmala, the Dedicated Freight Corridors, USBRL as a national project, Polavaram, Amaravati) are not comparable with a single commissioned asset such as Bhakra Dam or Tarapur Units 1–2. Kind is a graphic class, not a budget head. Scale is landmark, trunk, or civic: a Union template, a regional system, or a city work that still belongs on a national map. Displacement household counts are not averaged.
